notes: A096127_eq_succ_iff: for n >= 2, a n = n + 1 <-> IsPrimePow n, with a n = Nat.findGreatest (fun k => n! ^ k ∣ (n^2)!) ((n^2)!) as in the entry. Route: Legendre (p-1)v_p(m!) = m - s_p(m); digit sum subadditive (from a!b! | (a+b)!) and submultiplicative, so s(n^2) <= s(n)^2; (n+c)(n-t) <= n^2 - t^2 when c <= t = s_p(n) <= n, and s_p(n) >= 2 at every p iff n is not a prime power. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (agreement with the b-file, n <= 5000, checked by certificate/check.py).
